description: Capture a real-time traffic snapshot on a router interface. RouterOS runs the capture for `duration` seconds; the tool returns the flows of the final update with their TX/RX rates in bits per second and packets per second. Not auto-retried.

interface.description: Interface name to monitor (e.g. ether1, bridge1)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.
